description: This file defines a custom UI control class 'FlipButtons' for a Windows UWP application, extending ToggleButton with additional properties for styling and behavior, including handling key events and a dependency property for button identification.

classes.name: FlipButtons
classes.description: A sealed class extending ToggleButton, providing additional dependency properties for button identification and styling, with custom key event handling.

methods.name: OnKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides the key down event to ignore the Enter key.

methods.name: OnKeyUp
methods.description: Overrides the key up event to ignore the Enter key.

methods.name: OnButtonIdPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the ButtonId property, updating the CommandParameter accordingly.
